office_enhancement_status.title: Office Enhancement Status
office_enhancement_status.description: Check the Office补强 runtime: artifact-tool, PyMuPDF, lxml, pywin32, Node.js and PowerPoint/WPS COM registration.

artifact_build_overlay.title: Build Editable PowerPoint Overlay
artifact_build_overlay.description: Use the installed @oai/artifact-tool through a fixed structured adapter to build one editable PPTX overlay slide containing shapes, text, images and connectors. Does not execute caller-supplied JavaScript.

pptx_inspect.title: Inspect PPTX Package
pptx_inspect.description: Inspect PPTX slides, shape counts, text previews, masters, layouts and media through ZIP/OpenXML without changing the file.

pptx_merge_overlay.title: Merge Editable Overlay into PPTX
pptx_merge_overlay.description: Merge editable shapes, connectors and media from an overlay PPTX into a target slide using zipfile+lxml while preserving the original deck package, masters and unrelated slides.

powerpoint_inspect.title: Inspect PowerPoint Rendering Geometry
powerpoint_inspect.description: Open a PPTX with local Microsoft PowerPoint COM and inspect actual shape/text geometry, including likely text overflow.

powerpoint_render_slide.title: Render PowerPoint Slide
powerpoint_render_slide.description: Render one PPTX slide to PNG with the locally installed Microsoft PowerPoint engine for visual QA.

powerpoint_render_pdf.title: Render PowerPoint to PDF
powerpoint_render_pdf.description: Render a PPTX to PDF with the locally installed Microsoft PowerPoint engine for full-deck QA.

pdf_extract_images.title: Extract PDF Images
pdf_extract_images.description: Extract embedded raster images from selected PDF pages with PyMuPDF.

pdf_render_region.title: Render PDF Region
pdf_render_region.description: Render a full PDF page or selected clip rectangle to PNG with PyMuPDF, including vector charts that are not embedded raster images.
